newsitem.title: POLAND: Large private Polish firms plan lobby group.
newsitem.headline: Large private Polish firms plan lobby group.

text.p: Some of Poland's largest private and privatising firms will form a lobbying organisation to influence political opinion and economic legislation, the president of food trader Agros said.

Zofia Gaber told a National Chamber of Commerce meeting on Friday that the Union of Polish Industry, Trade and Finance should group about 200 firms such as Agros, chemicals trader Ciech SA, metals trader Impexmetal SA, air carrier PLL LOT SA and insurer Warta.
"It's to be a source of opinion for political circles taking legislative initiatives in the economic sphere," Gaber said.
She did not say when the group might become active.
